inland.bathymetry.aggregate.name: Inland Water Depth (combined surveys)
inland.bathymetry.aggregate.summary: Surveyed depth of inland water, assembled from every public agency that publishes it as a map service: the Minnesota DNR, the Ohio DNR, MassWildlife and MassGIS, the North Dakota GIS Hub and Game and Fish Department, the Great Lakes Commission, and NOAA's National Centers for Coastal Ocean Science. No single agency surveys the nation's lakes, so coverage is the union of what these programmes have measured — dense in the states that run lake survey programmes, absent in those that do not.
inland.bathymetry.aggregate.attribution: Inland depth surveys courtesy of the Minnesota DNR, Ohio DNR, MassWildlife/MassGIS, North Dakota GIS Hub, the Great Lakes Commission and NOAA NCCOS
